description: Arm a price trigger with webhook delivery. Arms a single-fire price trigger. NythosX checks the price every minute and POSTs a JSON event to your HTTPS webhook on the first crossing: {event:"trigger.fired", id, symbol, direction, price, fired_price, fired_at}, signed with HMAC-SHA256 (header X-NythosX-Signature: sha256=<hex> over the raw body, key = returned secret). Retries up to 5 times (8s timeout per attempt, until your endpoint returns 2xx); after 5 failed attempts delivery is marked failed — check status free with get_trigger_status (REST: GET /api/v1/triggers/status?id=) to see delivery_attempts/last_error. Expires after ttl_hours (default 168, max 720); cancel any time before it fires, free, with disarm_price_trigger (REST: POST /api/v1/triggers/cancel with {id, secret}) — the arm fee is not refunded, it paid for the monitoring already done. Costs $0.02 USDC per call (x402).

webhook_url.description: Public HTTPS URL that receives the signed trigger.fired event
